summary: Python 3 dicts lack iterkeys/itervalues/iteritems; use keys/values/items (with | list) for compatibility.
questions: Why does iteritems() not work in my template?
What replaces iteritems in Ansible on Python 3?

answer_card.title: Replace iteritems() with items()
answer_card.answer_md:
Python 3 has no `iterkeys`, `itervalues`, or `iteritems`. Use:

```yaml
loop: "{{ hosts.items() | list }}"
```
